Fixed the paging/plain override bug.

- Removed clap cross-overrides between `--plain`, `--paging`, and `--no-paging` in `src/bin/bat/clap_app.rs`.
- Replaced them with explicit argument-order handling in `src/bin/bat/app.rs:98`, so simple `--plain` no longer overrides `--paging`, while `-pp`/`-P` still disable paging unless a later `--paging` value takes precedence.

- `cargo test --test integration_tests` — 154 passed
- Full `cargo test` — passed
